Delete your NEVORA account
How to delete your account and what happens to your records.
You can ask us to delete your NEVORA account and the information linked to it, in the app or on the web.
In the app or on the web
Open Profile, choose Delete my account, read what happens, re-enter your password and confirm. If you’ve uninstalled the app, sign in to NEVORA on the web and do the same; the page opens after you sign in.
If you can’t sign in, use Forgot password? first, or email support@thevelani.com and we’ll help you confirm it’s you.
Start deletion request
What happens next
When you confirm, we save your request and show you a reference such as DEL-7KQ2M9XA. You’re signed out on every device and can’t sign in again. We aim to delete your account within 30 calendar days after we receive the request, and we email you when it’s done if we have your email address. Quote your reference to support@thevelani.com to ask about it.
What is removed
Your account and the information linked to it that can be deleted: your profile, sign-in details, sessions, notification subscriptions, calendar feed links and the content you contributed. Provider-held copies remain subject to applicable obligations and retention periods. This does not promise immediate erasure of all provider, backup or mailbox copies.
